
#XCELL HPV-independent comparison by PDL1 expression

```{r}
library(coxphf)
library(knitr)
library(openxlsx)
library(immunedeconv)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(survminer)
library(stringr)
```

#Kaplan Meyer death individual plot
```{r}
TP53status_clinical_HPVind$death_disease_60m <- factor(
  TP53status_clinical_HPVind$death_disease_60m,
  levels = c(0,1),
  labels = c("No", "Yes")
)

# Create the survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(time = TP53status_clinical_HPVind$time_death_surv_60m, 
                 event = as.numeric(TP53status_clinical_HPVind$death_disease_60m == "Yes"))

# Fit the Kaplan-Meier survival model
km_fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category, data = TP53status_clinical_HPVind)

 
# Define custom colors for groups
custom_colors <- c("Negative" = "skyblue1", "Positive" = "skyblue4")

# Kaplan-Meier survival curves
p <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit, 
  data = TP53status_clinical_HPVind,
  pval = TRUE,                    
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curve by PDL1_death",
  risk.table = TRUE,              
  risk.table.height = 0.3,        
  xlab = "Time to Event (Months)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",   
  break.time.by = 10,             
  palette = custom_colors,        # <-- apply custom colors
  legend = c(0.8, 0.2),           
  legend.title = "PDL1 status",   
  legend.labs = c("Negative", "Positive")  # match your groups
)

print(p)
```
  








# XCELL
```{r}
hpv_ind_xcell <- deconvolute(counts_HPV_Independent, "xcell")


hpv_ind_xcell_long <- hpv_ind_xcell %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -cell_type, # All columns except `cell_type`
    names_to = "Sample", 
    values_to = "Fraction"
  )

analysis_data <- hpv_ind_xcell_long %>%
  left_join(TP53status_clinical_HPVind, by = c( "Sample"="id"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(stringr)


# ============================================================
# 0. Prepare PDL1 status (drop "Unknown", set factor levels)
# ============================================================

analysis_data_pdl1 <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category != "Unknown") %>%
  mutate(
    pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
      levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 1. Wilcoxon test per cell type + BH-FDR correction
#    (mirrors `results_hpv` / the corrected `results_p53`)
# ============================================================

results_pdl1 <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category), !is.na(Fraction)) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_negative = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"),
    n_positive = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"),
    p_value    = wilcox.test(Fraction ~ pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)$p.value,
    median_negative = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_positive = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across ALL cell types tested
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# View all results
results_pdl1


# ============================================================
# 2. Keep only FDR-significant cell types
# ============================================================

significant_results <- results_pdl1 %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

significant_cell_types <- significant_results$cell_type

significant_data <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% significant_cell_types) %>%
  left_join(
    significant_results %>%
      select(cell_type, p_value, FDR, median_negative, median_positive),
    by = "cell_type"
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Boxplot/jitter panel of FDR-significant cell types
#    (guarded in case nothing survives correction)
# ============================================================

if (length(significant_cell_types) == 0) {

  message("No cell types reached FDR < 0.05 for PDL1 status within HPV-independent tumors.")

} else {

  analysis_data_significant <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
    filter(
      cell_type %in% significant_cell_types,
      !is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      !is.na(Fraction)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = significant_cell_types),
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
        pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
        levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
      )
    )

  # Check how many observations each cell type has
  print(table(analysis_data_significant$cell_type))

  plot_labels <- significant_results %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = significant_cell_types),
      FDR_label = paste0("FDR = ", format.pval(FDR, digits = 2, eps = 0.001))
    )

  PDL1plot <- ggplot(
    analysis_data_significant,
    aes(x = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category, y = Fraction, fill = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(width = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      width = 0.08,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~cell_type,
      scales = "free_y",
      nrow = 3,
      ncol = 4
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = plot_labels,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = FDR_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = "skyblue1", "Positive" = "skyblue4")
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Negative" = "dodgerblue3", "Positive" = "darkblue")
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    labs(
      title = "Cell Type Fractions by PDL1 Status (HPV-independent)",
      x = "PDL1 Immune Cells Status",
      y = "xCell Score",
      fill = "PDL1 Status",
      color = "PDL1 Status"
    ) +

    theme(
      panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10))

  print(PDL1plot)

}




# ============================================================
# 5. Scores (microenvironment / immune / stroma): FDR version
#    (mirrors the "For scores" section in your original script)
# ============================================================

hpv_ind_xcell <- deconvolute(counts_HPV_Independent, "xcell")

hpv_ind_xcell_long <- hpv_ind_xcell %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -cell_type, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Fraction")

analysis_data_full <- hpv_ind_xcell_long %>%
  left_join(TP53status_clinical_HPVind, by = c("Sample" = "id"))

scores_only <- c("microenvironment score", "immune score", "stroma score")

analysis_data_scores <- analysis_data_full %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% scores_only)

unique(analysis_data_scores$cell_type)

scores_data <- analysis_data_scores %>%
  filter(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category != "Unknown") %>%
  select(Sample, cell_type, Fraction, pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category), !is.na(Fraction)) %>%
  mutate(
    pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
      levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
    )
  )

table(scores_data$pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)
unique(scores_data$cell_type)

# --- Wilcoxon tests + BH-FDR correction across the 3 xCell scores ---
results_scores_pdl1 <- scores_data %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_negative = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"),
    n_positive = sum(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"),
    median_negative = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_positive = median(Fraction[pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = wilcox.test(Fraction ~ pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

results_scores_pdl1
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. xCell scores: p-value + FDR
# ============================================================

score_order <- c(
  "microenvironment score",
  "immune score",
  "stroma score"
)

scores_data <- scores_data %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = factor(
      cell_type,
      levels = score_order
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Labels with both nominal p-value and FDR
# ------------------------------------------------------------

score_labels <- results_scores_pdl1 %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = factor(
      cell_type,
      levels = score_order
    ),

    p_label = case_when(
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "p < 0.01",
      TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
    ),

    FDR_label = case_when(
      FDR < 0.01 ~ "FDR < 0.01",
      TRUE ~ paste0("FDR = ", sprintf("%.3f", FDR))
    ),

    label = paste0(
      p_label,
      "\n",
      FDR_label
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

PDL1plot_scores_FDR <- ggplot(
  scores_data,
  aes(
    x = cell_type,
    y = Fraction,
    fill = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.65,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.08,
      dodge.width = 0.6
    )
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = score_labels,
    aes(
      x = cell_type,
      y = Inf,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative" = "skyblue1",
      "Positive" = "skyblue4"
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Negative" = "dodgerblue3",
      "Positive" = "darkblue"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "microenvironment score" = "Microenvironment score",
      "immune score" = "Immune score",
      "stroma score" = "Stroma score"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  labs(
    title = "xCell Scores by PDL1 Status (HPV-independent)",
    subtitle = "Nominal p-value and BH-adjusted FDR",
    x = "Score Type",
    y = "xCell Score",
    fill = "PDL1 Status",
    color = "PDL1 Status"
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

PDL1plot_scores_FDR
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. Individual cell types with nominal p < 0.1
#    Plot both nominal p-value and BH-FDR
# ============================================================

nominal_results <- results_pdl1 %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.1) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

nominal_cell_types <- nominal_results$cell_type

print(nominal_results)
print(nominal_cell_types)

if (length(nominal_cell_types) == 0) {

  message(
    paste0(
      "No individual cell types reached nominal p < 0.1 ",
      "for PDL1 status within HPV-independent tumors."
    )
  )

} else {


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Data for nominally associated cell types
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  analysis_data_nominal <- analysis_data_pdl1 %>%
    filter(
      cell_type %in% nominal_cell_types,
      !is.na(pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      !is.na(Fraction)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(
        cell_type,
        levels = nominal_cell_types
      ),
      pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category = factor(
        pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
        levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
      )
    )

  print(table(analysis_data_nominal$cell_type))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  nominal_labels <- nominal_results %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = factor(
        cell_type,
        levels = nominal_cell_types
      ),

      p_label = case_when(
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "p < 0.01",
        TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))
      ),

      FDR_label = case_when(
        FDR < 0.01 ~ "FDR < 0.01",
        TRUE ~ paste0("FDR = ", sprintf("%.3f", FDR))
      ),

      label = paste0(
        p_label,
        "\n",
        FDR_label
      )
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  PDL1plot_nominal <- ggplot(
    analysis_data_nominal,

      x = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category,
      y = Fraction,
      fill = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category

  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.45,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = pdl1_immune_cells_pos_category),
      width = 0.08,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.65
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~cell_type,
      scales = "free_y",
      nrow = 3,
      ncol = 4
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = nominal_labels,
      aes(
        x = 1.5,
        y = Inf,
        label = label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Negative" = "skyblue1",
        "Positive" = "skyblue4"
      )
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Negative" = "dodgerblue3",
        "Positive" = "darkblue"
      )
    ) +

    theme_minimal() +

    labs(
      title = "Cell Types with Nominal p < 0.1 by PDL1 Status",
      subtitle = "HPV-independent tumors; nominal p-value and BH-adjusted FDR",
      x = "PDL1 Immune Cells Status",
      y = "xCell Score",
      fill = "PDL1 Status",
      color = "PDL1 Status"
    ) +

    theme(

      strip.text = element_text(

        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 16,
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(
      labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)
    )

  print(PDL1plot_nominal)
}
```
